''Polystachya neobenthamia'' is a species of [[flowering plant]]s from the orchid family, [[Orchidaceae]].<ref name = "POWO" /> It is terrestrial,<ref name = "Russell et al., 2010">Russell, A., Samuel, R., Rupp, B., Barfuss, M. H., Šafran, M., Besendorfer, V., & Chase, M. W. (2010). [https://www.academia.edu/download/52319861/Phylogenetics_and_cytology_of_a_pantropi20170326-18504-136rh03.pdf "Phylogenetics and cytology of a pantropical orchid genus Polystachya (Polystachyinae, Vandeae, Orchidaceae): Evidence from plastid DNA sequence data."] Taxon, 59(2), 389-404.</ref> [[Lithophile|lithophilic]] and grows among leaf litter and other detritus on rock faces. It is [[Endemism|endemic]] to [[Tanzania]].

== Description ==
This species produces slender, reed-like stems, which bear distichously arranged, linear leaves. The inflorescence is erect and the rachis is bent apically.<ref name = "Russell et al., 2010" /><ref>Mytnik-Ejsmont, J., & Szlachetko, D. L. (2011). [https://yadda.icm.edu.pl/yadda/element/bwmeta1.element.dl-catalog-c2e746bc-6a8d-46ee-84ea-7e03ff77f0e8/c/90.pdf "Isochilostachya Mytnik and Szlach., gen. nov., a new genus of Polystachyinae Schltr.(Orchidaceae)."] Acta Societatis Botanicorum Poloniae, 80(1).</ref> The flowers have four laterally flattened pollinia.<ref>Dressler, R. L., & Dodson, C. H. (1960). [https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Robert-Dressler-2/publication/256317455_Classification_and_Phylogeny_in_the_Orchidacea/links/00b49523b2c3e92e82000000/Classification-and-Phylogeny-in-the-Orchidacea.pdf "Classification and phylogeny in the Orchidacea."] Annals of the Missouri Botanical Garden, 25-68.</ref> The pollinia are relatively hard.<ref>Poinar, G., & Rasmussen, F. N. (2017). [https://www.researchgate.net/profile/George-Poinar/publication/315920359_Orchids_from_the_past_with_a_new_species_in_Baltic_amber/links/59c3fc7e0f7e9b07cbb9d534/Orchids-from-the-past-with-a-new-species-in-Baltic-amber.pdf "Orchids from the past, with a new species in Baltic amber."] Botanical Journal of the Linnean Society, 183(3), 327-333.</ref>

== Taxonomy ==
It was formerly placed in a separate, monotypic genus ''Neobenthamia'' Rolfe under the name ''Neobenthamia gracilis'' Rolfe. This is however now a synonym of ''Polystachya neobenthamia'' Schltr.<ref name = "POWO">{{cite POWO |id=654451-1 |title=''Polystachya neobenthamia'' Schltr.|accessdate=30 October 2022}}</ref> Under the inclusion of '' P. neobenthamia'' the genus ''Polystachya'' is a monophyletic group. This species is the sister group to ''[[Polystachya dendrobiiflora]]''.<ref name = "Russell et al., 2010" />
